name: pierce
caption:
THE BLOCK 🎮🏀 May 4, 2014. Game 7 vs Brooklyn. Down 1, 6 seconds left.

• 48-34, our best record ever at the time, first playoffs since 2008
• Game 7: Kyle Lowry has 28
• Last shot: Paul Pierce blocks Lowry at the buzzer
• Final: Nets 104, us 103
• 5 years later, we win it all

Most painful loss in our history? 👇

beats.head: TRAINER CARD
beats.vo: Twenty fourteen. We go forty-eight and thirty-four, our best record ever at the time, and make the playoffs for the first time since two thousand eight.

beats.head: GAME 7
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Game seven against Brooklyn. Kyle Lowry has twenty-eight. We're down one, six seconds left, and the ball is in his hands.

beats.head: THE BLOCK
beats.name: PIERCE
beats.vo: Lowry drives... and Paul Pierce blocks it at the buzzer.

beats.head: REVENGE
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Five years later, Kyle and us got our revenge. A ring.

beats.head: THE BLOCK
beats.vo: Most painful loss in our history? Comment below.

facts.claim: 2013-14 Raptors: 48-34, best record in franchise history at the time, first playoffs since 2008; lost Game 7 to Brooklyn on May 4, 2014; won the title 5 years later in 2019
ESPN play-by-play: Raptors timeout with 6.0 (6) seconds left in the 4th quarter; 0.0 Paul Pierce blocks Kyle Lowry's jumper; down 1
